title: Lost in the Request: How Communication Variation Disrupts Retrieval and Action in Email Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance degradation (accuracy, recall, and task success) of RAG and agentic email assistants when canonical requests are transformed into specific English dialects (Indian, Singaporean, Black South African, and Nigerian English) using a rule-based transducer.

Comparing the end-to-end success and retrieval metrics of email agents when user requests are rewritten into different communication styles (indirect, formal, casual, verbose, emotionally charged, and non-grammatical) using an LLM rewriter, while preserving the core intent.
